entities.name: Histone H3 acetylation at Nav1.7 promoter

relationships.subject: Oxaliplatin
relationships.evidence_quote: both the activity and expression of SIRT1 were significantly decreased in rat DRG following oxaliplatin treatment

relationships.subject: Oxaliplatin
relationships.evidence_quote: oxaliplatin treatment enhanced the action potential firing frequency of DRG neurons and the expression of Nav1.7 in DRG

relationships.subject: Resveratrol
relationships.evidence_quote: The activator of SIRT1, resveratrol, not only increased the activity and expression of SIRT1, but also attenuated the mechanical allodynia following oxaliplatin treatment.

relationships.subject: SIRT1
relationships.evidence_quote: both the expression of Nav1.7 and histone H3 acetylation at the Nav1.7 promoter were upregulated in the DRG by local knockdown of SIRT1 with SIRT1 siRNA in naive rats

relationships.subject: ProTx II
relationships.evidence_quote: blocking Nav1.7 by ProTx II (a selective Nav1.7 channel blocker) reversed oxaliplatin-induced mechanical allodynia

key_findings: Oxaliplatin reduces SIRT1 in DRG, relieving epigenetic (histone H3 acetylation) suppression of Nav1.7 and driving mechanical allodynia.
SIRT1 activation by resveratrol or Nav1.7 block by ProTx II reverses oxaliplatin-induced allodynia in rats.
